start: Owner on Workout plans ("Send members their routines"); no plans yet

steps.action: Open Workout plans
user_sees: "No workout plans yet": "Make a plan once (for example “Beginner 3 days”) and send it to members or to everyone on a membership plan."
Button "+ New plan"
must_not: The page refused to this sign-in

steps.action: Tap "+ New plan", then "Start empty" ("Pick every exercise yourself")
user_sees: A sheet "New workout plan" with a first day
must_not: A saved plan before Save

steps.action: Type a plan name, add an exercise from the list with sets and reps, tick two members under "Send to"
user_sees: The exercise with its sets and rep range
must_not: An exercise typed by hand accepted without its main muscle

steps.action: Tap "Save plan"
user_sees: "Saving…", then "“<name>” saved and sent."
The plan in the list with "Sent to 2 members" and "1 day · 1 exercise"
must_not: Two plans saved by two taps
"1 days" or "1 exercises"
The plan saved without the name of who made it

start: Other way in: a ready-made program, owner

steps.action: Tap "+ New plan"
user_sees: "Start from a ready plan and change anything you like, or start empty."
A list of ready plans, then "Start empty"
must_not: An empty list of ready plans

steps.action: Pick a ready plan
user_sees: The builder filled with its days and exercises, sets and rep ranges, no weights
must_not: An exercise missing from a day
Weights filled in that nobody typed

steps.action: Change one exercise, tick nobody, tap "Save plan"
user_sees: "“<name>” saved. Tick members to send it."
The plan reads "Not sent to anyone yet"
must_not: The plan sent to someone
The ready plan itself changed for next time

start: Other way in: a member's page, "Send a plan"

steps.action: On a member's page open the plan sender
user_sees: A sheet "Send a plan to <name>" with the gym's open plans; a plan they already get says so
"Start from a ready plan" ("Beginner to advanced, filled in for you") and "Make a new plan"
must_not: Withdrawn plans in the list

steps.action: Tap a plan they do not get yet
user_sees: The plan is sent; an Undo is offered
must_not: The plan taken away from the members who already had it
A change another desk made meanwhile overwritten

steps.action: Tap Undo
user_sees: The member no longer gets the plan
must_not: Other members taken off the plan

steps.action: Leave the name empty and tap "Save plan"
user_sees: "Give the plan a name."
must_not: A nameless plan saved

steps.action: Remove every exercise from a day and save
user_sees: "Add at least one exercise to <day>."
must_not: An empty day sent to members

steps.action: Type lowest reps 12 and highest 8, save
user_sees: "<exercise> (<day>): the lowest reps can’t be more than the highest."
must_not: The two numbers swapped silently

steps.action: Add a 15th day
user_sees: "A plan can have at most 14 days."
must_not: A plan the member app cannot read

steps.action: Fill long notes on many exercises and save
user_sees: "This plan is too big to send. Split it into two plans, or shorten the notes."
must_not: A plan cut short without a word

start: Owner with one saved plan sent to two members

steps.action: Tap Edit, change the reps, tap "Save changes"
user_sees: "“<name>” updated."
must_not: A second plan made instead of the change

steps.action: Tap the copy button of the plan
user_sees: The builder with a copy, a new name
must_not: The copy already sent to the same members without a look

steps.action: Tap "Withdraw"
user_sees: "Withdraw this plan?": "<name> will stop going to members. Routines already on their phones stay there, but get no more changes. You can’t send this plan again; make a copy of it instead."
Buttons "Keep it" and "Withdraw"
must_not: The plan withdrawn without the question

steps.action: Tap "Withdraw"
user_sees: "Plan withdrawn."
The plan under "Withdrawn plans (1)" with only a copy button
must_not: The plan deleted
Routines removed from members' phones
An Edit or send button on a withdrawn plan

steps.action: Edit a plan that another desk changed a minute ago and save
user_sees: A refusal in plain words; the sheet stays open
must_not: The other person's change overwritten silently

start: Owner; a plan sent to one member by name and to everyone on the "Gold" membership plan

steps.action: Read the plan's line in the list
user_sees: "Sent to 1 member · Gold plan"
must_not: "Gold plan plan"
Membership plans that no longer exist named

steps.action: A member whose Gold plan ended yesterday opens the member app
user_sees: unknown
must_not: New changes of the plan still going to a member whose membership ended (they get it only while a Gold plan covers today)

steps.action: A member not ticked and not on Gold opens the member app
user_sees: No such routine
must_not: The plan, its notes or the trainer's video shown to a member it was not sent to

steps.action: Withdraw the plan
user_sees: "Plan withdrawn."
must_not: Routines already on phones deleted (the words say they stay)
